نشتهي (form VIII)
# نَشْتَهِي (naštahī) /naʃ.ta.hiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# نَشْتَهِيَ (naštahiya) /naʃ.ta.hi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
